subject: Absenteeism Policy Review and Website Platform Update
overview: The subcommittee voted to review and update several district attendance policies to be more family-centered and received a progress report on a new website platform launching in Summer 2022.

items.title: Absenteeism and Truancy Notifications
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to review and recommend revisions for five district policies (JEC, JED, JF-R, JHBA, and JHB) to ensure attendance notifications are supportive and aligned with current health protocols. Members and administration discussed making the annual truancy letter from the District Attorney more family-centered and less punitive in tone.

items.title: Communications Strategy Update
items.summary: Administration announced the district is transitioning to the Final Site platform for a new website and mobile-friendly communication system scheduled to launch in Summer 2022. The new platform will include school-based support staff, integrated text messaging, and enhanced translation and accessibility features.
